about.name: Rajpreet Singh Nayyar
about.title: VP, Lead Software Engineer — Chase Travel
about.bio: I lead backend engineering for Checkout and Loyalty at JPMorgan Chase Travel — designing API-driven microservices, driving production reliability, and scaling reward decisioning for millions of travelers.

timeline.description: Leading technical strategy and execution for Checkout and Loyalty platforms within Chase Travel.
achievements: Providing technical leadership across Cart, Checkout, and Loyalty — driving system design, architectural direction, and engineering standards.
Guiding teams on production reliability, observability, and evolution of rules-heavy reward and promotion systems.
Partnering with product and platform stakeholders to deliver resilient, high-traffic Checkout experiences.

timeline.description: Subject Matter Expert for Checkout loyalty and promotions. Owned production reliability and delivered major rewards initiatives.
achievements: Served as SME for Cart & Checkout, owning technical and business workflows across booking, rewards, and purchase flows.
Delivered major initiatives: Dynamic Points Burn, Chase Promotional Offers, Preserve Burn, and Cruise onboarding.
Designed a rule-driven points allocation algorithm for Preserve Burn; validated the solution during on-site workshops in India prior to go-live.

timeline.description: Code owner for Cart Engine with squad-level delivery leadership across Checkout initiatives.
achievements: Code owner for Cart Engine — responsible for architecture decisions, daily code reviews, and code quality.
Led cross-functional squads to ship Fee in Points and the Traveler Information Page, a critical Checkout component.
Built real-time dashboards in Grafana and Kibana; used Dynatrace for performance monitoring and end-to-end session tracing.

timeline.description: Backend and UI contributions across Cart/Checkout services, payments flows, and observability.
achievements: Built backend APIs for Cart and Checkout using C# and .NET Core for core booking and purchase flows.
Delivered Cart-Level Payments and PCI-compliant services including Fraud Check, One-Use Card, and BIN Validation.
Built Angular UI components for Cart/Checkout with Lit Elements; applied TDD, microservices, and BFF patterns.

timeline.description: Built a data analytics and visualization UI, integrating interactive charts and automated reporting.
achievements: Built a data visualization UI using Angular for the ORXe Data Analyzer, featuring interactive CanvasJS charts.
Developed an Email API for automated delivery of statistical reports; integrated Angular Material components.
